list.name: base
list.label: Counts as active
list.description: played: started a game, relay or offline. connected: authenticated to the relay, relay only. any: either.

panels.title: Daily active
panels.description: distinct handles active on the last day of the range; today is partial when the range ends now

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)) SELECT count(DISTINCT username) AS dau FROM activity WHERE day = date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/MAU)
panels.description: share of the monthly active base that was active on the last day

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)) SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT username) FROM activity WHERE day = date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) / nullif((SELECT count(DISTINCT username) FROM activity WHERE day > date(date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch'), '-28 day') AND day <= date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')), 0), 1) AS stickiness

panels.title: Daily, weekly and monthly active players
panels.description: rolling 1, 7 and 28 day distinct-handle counts, recomputed for every day in the range; the windows reach back before the range start, so the left edge is not truncated

targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), spine(day) AS (SELECT date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT date(day, '+1 day') FROM spine WHERE day < date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day = s.day) AS dau, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day > date(s.day, '-7 day') AND a.day <= s.day) AS wau, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day > date(s.day, '-28 day') AND a.day <= s.day) AS mau FROM spine s ORDER BY s.day
targets.rawQueryText: WITH RECURSIVE activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), spine(day) AS (SELECT date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT date(day, '+1 day') FROM spine WHERE day < date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day = s.day) AS dau, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day > date(s.day, '-7 day') AND a.day <= s.day) AS wau, (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day > date(s.day, '-28 day') AND a.day <= s.day) AS mau FROM spine s ORDER BY s.day

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/MAU)
panels.description: share of each day's 28-day active base that was active that day; roughly, how many days a month an active player shows up

targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), spine(day) AS (SELECT date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT date(day, '+1 day') FROM spine WHERE day < date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, round(100.0 * (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day = s.day) / nullif((SELECT count(DISTINCT a.username) FROM activity a WHERE a.day > date(s.day, '-28 day') AND a.day <= s.day), 0), 1) AS dau_mau FROM spine s ORDER BY s.day

panels.title: New, returning and resurrected players
panels.description: new is a handle's first ever activity; returning was also active in the previous 28 days; resurrected had been away longer than that

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS first_day FROM activity GROUP BY username), ranged AS (SELECT username, day FROM activity WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day = r.day THEN r.username END) AS new_players, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day < r.day AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.username = r.username AND a2.day < r.day AND a2.day >= date(r.day, '-28 day')) THEN r.username END) AS returning_players, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day < r.day AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.username = r.username AND a2.day < r.day AND a2.day >= date(r.day, '-28 day')) THEN r.username END) AS resurrected_players FROM ranged r JOIN first_seen f USING(username) GROUP BY r.day ORDER BY r.day
targets.rawQueryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS first_day FROM activity GROUP BY username), ranged AS (SELECT username, day FROM activity WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', r.day) AS INTEGER) AS t, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day = r.day THEN r.username END) AS new_players, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day < r.day AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.username = r.username AND a2.day < r.day AND a2.day >= date(r.day, '-28 day')) THEN r.username END) AS returning_players, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.first_day < r.day AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a2 WHERE a2.username = r.username AND a2.day < r.day AND a2.day >= date(r.day, '-28 day')) THEN r.username END) AS resurrected_players FROM ranged r JOIN first_seen f USING(username) GROUP BY r.day ORDER BY r.day

panels.title: Days active per player
panels.description: how many distinct days each handle was active inside the range

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), per_player AS (SELECT username, count(DISTINCT day) AS days FROM activity WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY username) SELECT CASE WHEN days = 1 THEN '1 day' WHEN days <= 3 THEN '2-3 days' WHEN days <= 7 THEN '4-7 days' WHEN days <= 14 THEN '8-14 days' ELSE '15+ days' END AS active_days, count(*) AS players, min(days) AS ord FROM per_player GROUP BY active_days ORDER BY ord
targets.rawQueryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), per_player AS (SELECT username, count(DISTINCT day) AS days FROM activity WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000 GROUP BY username) SELECT CASE WHEN days = 1 THEN '1 day' WHEN days <= 3 THEN '2-3 days' WHEN days <= 7 THEN '4-7 days' WHEN days <= 14 THEN '8-14 days' ELSE '15+ days' END AS active_days, count(*) AS players, min(days) AS ord FROM per_player GROUP BY active_days ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Weekly cohort retention
panels.description: rows are the Monday of the week a handle first appeared; W1 is the share of that cohort active again 7-13 days later, W2 14-20 days, and so on. A cell is blank when the window has not fully elapsed yet, never zero.

targets.queryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS first_day FROM activity GROUP BY username), cohorts AS (SELECT f.username, date(f.first_day, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) || ' day') AS cohort_week FROM first_seen f WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000), weeks AS (SELECT c.cohort_week, c.username, CAST((julianday(a.day) - julianday(c.cohort_week)) / 7 AS INTEGER) AS week_index FROM cohorts c JOIN activity a ON a.username = c.username WHERE a.day >= c.cohort_week) SELECT c.cohort_week AS cohort, count(DISTINCT c.username) AS players, CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+14 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 1 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W1", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+21 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 2 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W2", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+28 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 3 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W3", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+35 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 4 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W4", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+42 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 5 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W5", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+49 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 6 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W6", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+56 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 7 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W7", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+63 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 8 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W8" FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN weeks w ON w.username = c.username GROUP BY c.cohort_week ORDER BY c.cohort_week DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS first_day FROM activity GROUP BY username), cohorts AS (SELECT f.username, date(f.first_day, '-' || ((CAST(strftime('%w', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) + 6) % 7) || ' day') AS cohort_week FROM first_seen f WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', f.first_day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000), weeks AS (SELECT c.cohort_week, c.username, CAST((julianday(a.day) - julianday(c.cohort_week)) / 7 AS INTEGER) AS week_index FROM cohorts c JOIN activity a ON a.username = c.username WHERE a.day >= c.cohort_week) SELECT c.cohort_week AS cohort, count(DISTINCT c.username) AS players, CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+14 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 1 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W1", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+21 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 2 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W2", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+28 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 3 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W3", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+35 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 4 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W4", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+42 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 5 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W5", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+49 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 6 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W6", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+56 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 7 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W7", CASE WHEN date(c.cohort_week, '+63 day') > date('now') THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.week_index = 8 THEN w.username END) / count(DISTINCT c.username), 0) END AS "W8" FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN weeks w ON w.username = c.username GROUP BY c.cohort_week ORDER BY c.cohort_week DESC

panels.title: Returned within N days of first activity
panels.description: share of new handles that came back at least once within N days. Pooled across cohorts, and each point counts only handles old enough to have had N days to return, so the curve does not sag at the right edge.

targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE activity AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.username AS username, date(g.started_at) AS day FROM games g JOIN game_players p USING(game_id) WHERE p.is_bot = 0 AND g.started_at IS NOT NULL AND '$base' IN ('played', 'any') UNION SELECT DISTINCT c.username, date(c.ts) FROM client_connections c WHERE '$base' IN ('connected', 'any') AND c.username NOT IN (SELECT username FROM game_players WHERE is_bot = 1)), first_seen AS (SELECT username, min(day) AS first_day FROM activity GROUP BY username), eligible AS (SELECT username, first_day FROM first_seen WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', first_day) AS INTEGER) > $__from / 1000 AND CAST(strftime('%s', first_day) AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000), horizon(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM horizon WHERE n < 30) SELECT h.n AS days_since_first, round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM eligible e WHERE julianday(date('now')) - julianday(e.first_day) >= h.n AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity a WHERE a.username = e.username AND a.day > e.first_day AND a.day <= date(e.first_day, '+' || h.n || ' day'))) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM eligible e WHERE julianday(date('now')) - julianday(e.first_day) >= h.n), 0), 1) AS returned_pct FROM horizon h ORDER BY h.n
